veranderings.rede: 'Beweeg' is normally intransitive; 'nie vanself beweeg nie' is the natural Afrikaans for 'cannot move on its own'.
The reflexive 'hulleself skuif' is wooden; 'nie self skuif nie' says the same thing naturally.

veranderings.voor: Daardie spiere is die dele wat werk en die bene laat beweeg
veranderings.na: Daardie spiere doen die werk en laat die bene beweeg
veranderings.rede: 'Die dele wat werk' is vague and wooden; a direct verb reads more clearly with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: So kom daardie been in beweging en die dier se lyf skuif saam
veranderings.na: So kom daardie been in beweging, en die dier se lyf beweeg saam
veranderings.rede: AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb; 'skuif saam' usually means 'move up closer together', so 'beweeg saam' avoids the wrong reading.

veranderings.voor: 'n Spier kan net trek en hy kan nooit stoot nie
veranderings.na: 'n Spier kan net trek, en hy kan nooit stoot nie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
A muscle 'bult uit' in Afrikaans; 'bult op' is not the usual expression.

veranderings.voor: Jou elmboog is so 'n gewrig en jou arm
veranderings.na: Jou elmboog is so 'n gewrig, en jou arm
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: laat buig nie en gewrigte alleen ook nie
veranderings.na: laat buig nie, en gewrigte alleen kan dit ook nie
veranderings.rede: The elliptical second half is awkward to read; giving it its own verb and the AWS comma makes the two-part statement clear.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects; the protected words 'en geen been skuif nie' stay untouched.

veranderings.voor: Die gewrigte gee die plekke waar die bene kan swaai as 'n spier trek
veranderings.na: Die gewrigte is die plekke waar die bene kan swaai wanneer 'n spier trek
veranderings.rede: 'Gee die plekke' is wooden, and 'wanneer' is clearer than 'as', which a learner can read as 'like'.

veranderings.voor: sy vlerke af en op trek
veranderings.na: sy vlerke op en af trek
veranderings.rede: The fixed Afrikaans pair is 'op en af'; drop this if the down-first order was deliberate.

vlae.teks: By baie van hierdie gewrigte kan die bene teen mekaar beweeg.
vlae.rede: 'Teen mekaar beweeg' can be read as the bones rubbing against each other or as moving relative to each other; left unchanged because choosing between them means guessing the intended content.
